{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u067/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3ad525a5.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Return the lowest (tie: rightmost) nonzero 8-connected object, tightly cropped."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                        if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and
                                grid[p[0]][p[1]] != 0 and p not in seen):
                            seen.add(p)
                            stack.append(p)
            objects.append(cells)
    if not objects:
        return []
    cells = max(objects, key=lambda obj: (max(r for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)))
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[grid[r][c] if (r, c) in set(cells) else 0
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}
